upper-middle.notes: Two physical compartments. Individually measured source x seam anchors at y700 and y2400, with side-edge interpolation at y1500. Per-sleeve cap and foot heights measured from full-resolution endpoint crops now extend each outline to its photographed sleeve corners, approximately2-4px inside the sleeve. Existing side seam slopes are retained; left/right endpoint heights vary independently. The front divider and exposed white frame remain excluded. Rounded wear and tiny folded corner peaks are approximated by straight cap/foot edges. Nitty Gritty Dirt Band three-record box, Pink Floyd double sleeve and Elton John sleeve retain their measured larger widths. Unreadable, heavily worn or partly overlapping seams use bounded estimates; all68 original catalog IDs are retained. The rightmost cream sleeve is inset from the angled exposed white interior wall.

right.notes: Manual conservative 6-point sleeve traces in EXIF-transposed (browser displayed) 4032x3024 photo coordinates. Top caps, y1500 middle edges, and individual bottom contours are measured independently from visible spines and readable artist/title/catalogue anchors. These masks exclude white box framing, divider gaps, empty top/bay regions, and inter-sleeve black gaps; they are not uniform compartment subdivisions. Very small worn-edge sections between measured anchors are interpolated, with a 2px inset (1px on unresolved slot30). Slots04/30 retain the catalogue uncertainties. Book52 and 3LP box53 have separately measured broad tapered contours. Top-cap x positions use short local interpolation from the measured y500 edge; microcreases and torn fringe are not pixel-perfect segmentation.
